newsitem.title: JAPAN: Eisai shares jump on hopes of new product.
newsitem.headline: Eisai shares jump on hopes of new product.

text.p: Shares of pharmaceutical maker Eisai Co Ltd rose on Wednesday afternoon after the company said it would release information at 4 p.m. (0700 GMT) about authorities' approval of a product it is developing, traders said.
As of 0539 GMT, Eisai's share price was up 60 yen at 2,080 yen. Trading volume was 308,000 shares.
A spokeswoman for Eisai said earlier that the company plans to issue a statement simultaneously in the United States, but declined to elaborate on the contents of the announcement.
